name: pmmod
expr: y = pmmod(x, fc, fs, pi/4); y2 = pmmod(x, fc, fs, pi/4, pi/3);
comment: MATLAB pmmod: phase modulator y = cos(2π·Fc·t + phasedev·x + ini_phase). Covered: default (ini_phase=0) and explicit ini_phase forms, 100-sample column-vector input, sample points across the signal. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship pmmod in core (it's in the communications package); reports N/A.
